scenarios.pending_reason: not runnable as a measured scenario yet: the runner now seeds the unidentified vault records (pre.vault_records, with held affixes) and posts the order with the record ids ({{vault.N.id}}), but the instant stash payment (ADR 0029, agent/vaultpay) is a player-paid write, `debug paygold`, which the lab d2d build devp16 lacks (it ships in devp17) and which the bot and the fork refuse in a measured run (`no_writes` would be red). scenarios.notes: Hero in town, 6 unidentified held items (vault records), 5000 gold in the purse and none in the stash, knob loot.vaultRevealGold 1, an order for all 6 posted before the first town visit. Expected: all 6 records identified, the purse down by about 6 scrolls at the vendor price (80 each) and not below the potion-kit reserve, no item sold, the order ends done. RED on today's main is the order route not existing; GREEN is the physical chain buy, read, supersede.
